supplemental_user_authorization.scope: Prospective planning and review of revised Program 002 completeness semantics. This artifact grants no credential, network, acquisition, strategy, qualification, controlled, protected, PAPER, broker-write, or live authority.

provider_contract.documented_stock_bar_rule: A stock bar is emitted only when every OHLCV field is nonzero after eligible-trade aggregation. No bar is generated when an interval has no trades or only trades that cannot update every required price field.
provider_contract.documented_higher_timeframe_rule: Non-minute bars are aggregated from emitted minute bars using first open, maximum high, minimum low, last close, and summed volume.
provider_contract.incident_consistency: Two separately paginated, raw-byte-nonidentical attempts omitted the same two five-minute MDY intervals while all pagination, bounds, duplicate, parse, and transport controls passed.

amended_completeness_contract.canonical_grid: Every published Program 002 dataset still contains exactly one canonical OHLCV row for every authorized symbol and expected XNYS five-minute bar open.
amended_completeness_contract.provider_observed_grid: A provider response may omit only a coordinate enumerated by this amendment. Provider-observed rows and synthesized continuity rows are counted and identified separately.
eligibility: The complete unique next_page_token chain must terminate with null within the reviewed resource ceiling.
Every provider-observed record must pass the existing symbol, timestamp, ordering, OHLCV, duplicate, and authorized-boundary controls.
The actual missing set must be a subset of the two eligible coordinates and no other expected coordinate may be missing.
Each missing coordinate must have its exact immediate predecessor and successor as provider-observed bars for the same symbol and XNYS session.
No raw provider record may exist at the missing coordinate.
A provider-observed valid bar at an eligible coordinate always takes precedence and is never replaced.

synthesis.timestamp: the eligible missing XNYS five-minute bar open
synthesis.volume_interpretation: Zero means no complete provider OHLCV bar volume was observed for the canonical interval. It conservatively adds no unknown volume and is not a claim that no trade, quote, odd lot, or other market activity occurred.
synthesis.causality: No successor price, quote, future trade, candidate result, or strategy output contributes to the synthesized values.
synthesis.timing: Synthesize only after complete raw pagination and validation, then run the unchanged full-grid and six-source-bar thirty-minute structural checks.

failure_conditions: any missing coordinate outside the exact eligible set
an unbounded, leading, trailing, consecutive, cross-session, or cross-symbol gap
any duplicate, malformed, out-of-order, unauthorized, out-of-bound, or quarantined provider record
any pagination, transport, source, authority, proof, credential-identity, or raw-integrity failure

provenance_contract.raw_pages_and_raw_records: Retain exact provider bytes unchanged. Never insert a synthesized row into provider raw-record evidence.
provenance_contract.segment_evidence: Record the eligible coordinate set, actual provider-observed omission set, synthesis algorithm version, source predecessor timestamp, and synthesized canonical record in the create-only segment artifact.
provenance_contract.dataset_evidence: Record provider-observed row count, synthesized row count, each synthesized coordinate and source predecessor, normalization version, raw hashes, normalized fingerprint, and exact request-segment identities in the immutable manifest and raw-evidence header.
provenance_contract.identity: The normalization version and synthesis evidence must contribute to segment content identity, normalized fingerprint, raw-evidence fingerprint, dataset ID, manifest SHA-256, and downstream dataset binding.
provenance_contract.review: Independently review raw-to-canonical derivation and every synthesized row before quote acquisition or cost calibration.

expected_counts.interpretation: Existing expected_rows fields bind canonical published rows. Provider-observed and synthesized counts are separate mandatory evidence and must never be conflated.

research_semantics.change: Two exact provider omissions may become causal zero-volume continuity rows instead of terminating the whole Program 002 dataset.
research_semantics.price_rule: Prior observed close is the last eligible-trade price known before the missing interval. Carrying it forward adds no price move and does not use future information.
research_semantics.volume_rule: Zero adds no fabricated participation and preserves sums of provider-observed volume.
research_semantics.thirty_minute_effect: The synthesized rows add no high or low extreme and preserve the last provider-observed close as the 13:00-13:30 New York bucket close when the 13:25 row is absent.
research_semantics.decision_feature_effect: Both eligible coordinates occur after the frozen 11:30 New York decision and after the 09:30-11:30 same-clock volume window, so they cannot change that session's selection snapshot.
research_semantics.later_feature_effect: When 2020-12-04 enters a later session's twenty-session history, each zero-volume continuity row can conservatively affect the all-day median dollar-volume capacity input. The morning same-clock volume denominator is unaffected because both omissions are after 11:30 New York.
research_semantics.execution_and_metric_effect: The continuity rows remain part of the later price path and may affect structural aggregation or mark-to-market evidence. This is an explicit prospective research-semantic change, not an implementation-only repair.
research_semantics.fill_clock_safety: Neither eligible coordinate is one of the frozen 11:35, 11:40, 11:45, 13:35, 13:40, 13:45, 15:35, 15:40, or 15:45 New York fill clocks. Every fill remains priced from a provider-observed bar open.
not_allowed: using quote midpoints or a new provider
changing dates, symbols, feed, adjustment, candidate parameters, gates, cost calibration, or controlled/protected boundaries

implementation_prerequisites: finding-free independent exact-byte review of this amendment
implementation limited to the reviewed eligibility, synthesis, provenance, and validation rules
focused regressions for exact eligible gaps, observed-bar precedence, foreign gaps, unbounded gaps, provenance, raw immutability, and unchanged complete segments
new exact source commit and acquisition authority v6 bound to this amendment and its review
finding-free independent authority review and clean synchronized-main preflight before credential loading or any provider request

existing_context_dataset_disposition.disposition: Reuse the exact reviewed gap-free context dataset under its original normalization identity. Do not relabel, mutate, or reacquire it. Apply program-002-provider-omission-normalization-v2 to newly published exposed datasets.
